messages:
maya: Quick heads up — our infra-tool builder images are failing reproducibility checks in the publish pipeline. digests differ between eu and us registries.
jack: saw that too this morning. manifest probe in the pipeline shows different digest after registry-replica step.
elia: do we have logs? can we confirm it's not a pulled-upstream 'latest' base image change?
maya: pasted the failing bit below:

---
step: push-to-registry
output: remote: digest: sha256:aaa111 -> pushed
replica-sync: applied, digest: sha256:bbb222
error: digest mismatch for image infra-builder: expected sha256:aaa111, got sha256:bbb222
---

jack: looks like our replication system re-generates manifests and the digest changes (some registries recompute). probably metadata differences.
liam: convinced this is the cross-region mirror changing ordering of manifests which affects canonical digest. seen similar with GCR <-> ACR.
elia: we should pin base images in Dockerfile to sha256 rather than tags. also set BUILD_DATE and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH to deterministic values.
maya: agreed. also the builder injects a random layer id for buildkit cache busting — we need to ensure cache export/import uses the same key across runners.
jack: current kaniko config uses --snapshotMode=redo which can produce nondeterministic timestamps. switch to --reproducible-tar? (kaniko flag is --reproducible) and pass --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1
liam: to add: add a post-push step to annotate pushed image with origin_digest label and push that annotation to the registry so replicas can map back to original.
elia: we already generate SBOMs via syft in the pipeline but we don't attach them as OCI artifacts. attach SBOM as an OCI artifact and sign it with cosign.
maya: nice. pipeline changes I propose:
- pin FROM lines to sha256
- set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in build args
- enable kaniko/kaniko-repro flags
- emit SBOM and attach as oci artifact
- cosign sign both image and sbom
- write origin-digest annotation

jack: we also need a digest-gate in the gitops rollout: manifests must reference image@sha256 not :tag, otherwise deploy will pull the wrong one.
liam: +1. manifest-generator currently writes tag only. change generator to resolve tag -> digest using registry lookup at build time.
infra-bot: deploy-check: image references without @sha256 found in 7 manifests. failing rollouts will be blocked until resolved.
(infra-bot adds reaction :rotating_light:)
elia: one more ops/cost note — cross-region replication doubles egress cost for large builder images. maybe keep smaller base and use multi-stage to squash out heavy layers.
maya: good call. also we can TTL prune intermediate builder caches weekly to avoid storage bloat; add a cron job to blob storage GC.
jack: who wants the first PR? I'll take the manifest-generator change to resolve digest at CI time.
liam: I'll work on kaniko flags + SBOM attach step, and cosign integration.
maya: I'll update the Dockerfile templates to pin to sha256 and add SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH guidance in repo scaffolding.
elia: I'll open a short runbook for incident response when digest mismatches happen — include commands to inspect registry annotations and re-trigger replication.
jack: timeline? wdyt 2 sprints for all changes? some parts can be staged: digest-resolve + manifest-gate first.
maya: sounds good. action items in PRs and I'll link here.
devops-bot: note: created issue INFRA-998 "reproducible-builder-images + digest gating" and assigned maya/jack/liam. ETA 2026-04-08.
maya: thanks. leaving this thread open until the manifest-gate is deployed. :white_check_mark:
